161	        game.forces.player.set_friend(new_force, true)

171	-- opts.skip_clock = true defers team_clock_start + team_clock.on_claim until
172	-- the leader clicks "Start Playing" (used by the staged-start feature).
173	function M.claim_team_slot(player, opts)
174	    opts = opts or {}
175	    storage.team_pool = storage.team_pool or {}
176	    local slot = nil
177	    for i = 1, max_teams() do
178	        if storage.team_pool[i] == "available" then slot = i; break end
179	    end
180	    if not slot then
181	        player.print("No team slots available. All " .. max_teams() .. " teams are occupied.")
182	        return nil
183	    end
184	
185	    local force_name = "team-" .. slot
186	    local force = game.forces[force_name]
187	    if not force then return nil end
188	
189	    reset_force_state(force)
190	    copy_force_state(game.forces.player, force)
191	    -- force.reset() above wiped this force's chart, so re-reveal the landing pen
192	    -- for it -- otherwise the player sees a black island when they look back.
193	    pen_info_panel.chart_for(force)
194	
195	    -- Populate the full team state and raise on_team_created BEFORE putting the
196	    -- leader on the force. player.force = force synchronously fires
197	    -- on_player_changed_force -> on_player_joined_team, so writing the state
198	    -- first means that event (and any consumer's get_team_info from it) sees a
199	    -- fully-occupied team with its leader/clock set, and observes on_team_created
200	    -- first, rather than a half-written slot.
201	    storage.team_leader = storage.team_leader or {}
202	    storage.team_leader[force_name] = player.index
203	    storage.team_pool[slot] = "occupied"
204	
205	    -- Track whether THIS claim is the call that starts the clock, so we raise
206	    -- on_team_clock_started exactly once. A staged start defers the clock
207	    -- (skip_clock) and fires the event from pre_start.commit instead.
208	    local clock_started_now = false
209	    if not opts.skip_clock then
210	        storage.team_clock_start = storage.team_clock_start or {}
211	        if not storage.team_clock_start[force_name] then
212	            storage.team_clock_start[force_name] = game.tick
213	            clock_started_now = true
214	            log("[multi-team-support] team clock started for " .. force_name
215	                .. " at tick " .. game.tick)
216	        end
217	        team_clock.on_claim(force_name)
218	    end
219	
220	    planet_map.apply_force_locks(force)
221	    log("[multi-team-support] " .. player.name .. " claimed slot " .. slot
222	        .. " (" .. force_name .. ")")
223	    remote_api.raise_team_created(force_name, player.index)
224	    if clock_started_now then
225	        remote_api.raise_team_clock_started(force_name, storage.team_clock_start[force_name])
226	    end
227	
228	    -- Leader joins last: fires on_player_joined_team after the team is fully
229	    -- written and on_team_created has already been observed by consumers.
230	    player.force       = force
231	    force.custom_color = player.color
232	    return force_name
233	end

251	
252	    if storage.left_teams then

256	    storage.team_looking_for_more = storage.team_looking_for_more or {}
257	    storage.team_looking_for_more[force_name] = nil
258	    storage.lfm_ever_recruited = storage.lfm_ever_recruited or {}

328	function M.cleanup_force_surfaces(force_name)
329	    local deleted = {}
330	    local seen    = {}
331	
332	    -- Legacy / non-Space-Age cloned surfaces are named "team-N-<planet>".
333	    for _, surface in pairs(game.surfaces) do
334	        if surface.valid and surface.name:find("^" .. force_name:gsub("%-", "%%-") .. "%-") then
335	            if not seen[surface.name] then
336	                seen[surface.name] = true
337	                deleted[#deleted + 1] = surface.name
338	                game.delete_surface(surface)
339	            end
340	        end
341	    end
342	
343	    -- Space Age variants are named "mts-<planet>-N" and don't match the
344	    -- "team-N-" prefix above. Look them up via planet_map's force→variant
345	    -- map so they get deleted too; otherwise the next team that recycles
346	    -- this slot inherits the previous occupants' explored terrain.
347	    local variants = (storage.map_force_to_planets or {})[force_name] or {}
348	    for _, variant_name in pairs(variants) do
349	        local surface = game.surfaces[variant_name]
350	        if surface and surface.valid and not seen[surface.name] then
351	            seen[surface.name] = true
352	            deleted[#deleted + 1] = surface.name
353	            game.delete_surface(surface)
354	        end
355	    end
356	
357	    -- mts-v1 ephemeral surfaces (created via create_team_surface -- e.g. MTS
358	    -- Dimension Warp's dock / warp / dimension worlds) are tracked ONLY in the
359	    -- dedicated override map. They carry a consumer prefix ('mdw-...'), not
360	    -- 'team-N-', and aren't in the variant map, so BOTH scans above miss them --
361	    -- a disband would leak every one. Sweep them here and drop their ownership.
362	    local overrides = storage.surface_owner_overrides
363	    if overrides then
364	        for sname, owner in pairs(overrides) do
365	            if owner == force_name then
366	                local surface = game.surfaces[sname]
367	                if surface and surface.valid and not seen[sname] then
368	                    seen[sname] = true
369	                    deleted[#deleted + 1] = sname
370	                    game.delete_surface(surface)
371	                end
372	                overrides[sname] = nil
373	            end
374	        end
375	    end
376	
377	    local force = game.forces[force_name]
378	    if force then
379	        for _, platform in pairs(force.platforms) do
380	            if platform.valid then
381	                deleted[#deleted + 1] = platform.name
382	                platform.destroy()
383	            end
384	        end
385	    end
386	    storage.player_surfaces = storage.player_surfaces or {}
387	    for idx, ps in pairs(storage.player_surfaces) do
388	        for _, name in pairs(deleted) do
389	            if ps.name == name then storage.player_surfaces[idx] = nil; break end
390	        end
391	    end
392	    return deleted
393	end

395	-- ─── Remove from Team ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
396	
397	function M.remove_from_team(player)
398	    local old_force      = player.force
399	    local old_force_name = old_force.name
400	    local member_count   = force_member_count(old_force)
401	
402	    storage.left_teams = storage.left_teams or {}
403	    storage.left_teams[player.index] = storage.left_teams[player.index] or {}
404	    storage.left_teams[player.index][old_force_name] = true
405	
406	    storage.team_leader = storage.team_leader or {}
407	    local is_leader = (storage.team_leader[old_force_name] == player.index)
408	    local cn_player = helpers.colored_name(player.name, player.chat_color)
409	    local team_tag  = helpers.team_tag_with_leader(old_force_name)
410	
411	    -- If the team was in pre-start staging, restore the leaving player's permissions
412	    -- before changing their force (release_team_slot clears pre_start_pending via
413	    -- wipe_slot_state, so check it now while the flag is still set).
414	    if (storage.pre_start_pending or {})[old_force_name] then
415	        local default = game.permissions.get_group("Default")
416	        if default then default.add_player(player) end
417	    end
418	
419	    if member_count <= 1 then
420	        -- Restore anyone spectating this (about-to-be-released) team and any
421	        -- outside viewers of it, so no stale spectator state carries onto the
422	        -- recycled slot. (Members are already accounted for by the count above;
423	        -- this mainly clears viewers.)
424	        spectator.exit_all_for_force(old_force_name)
425	        -- Move the leaver off the team BEFORE tearing its surfaces down, so
426	        -- on_player_left_team (fired synchronously by player.force =) reaches
427	        -- consumers while the team's surfaces are still valid. release_team_slot
428	        -- still runs last, preserving the on_player_left_team -> on_team_released
429	        -- order.
430	        local spec_force = game.forces["spectator"]
431	        if spec_force then player.force = spec_force end
432	        local deleted  = M.cleanup_force_surfaces(old_force_name)
433	        M.release_team_slot(old_force_name)
434	        local msg = "[Team] " .. team_tag .. " has been disbanded."
435	        if #deleted > 0 then msg = msg .. " Their base has been cleaned up." end
436	        helpers.broadcast(msg)
437	    else
438	        local spec_force = game.forces["spectator"]
439	        if spec_force then player.force = spec_force end
440	        helpers.broadcast("[Team] " .. cn_player .. " has left " .. team_tag .. ".")
441	
442	        if is_leader then
443	            local new_leader = pick_new_leader(old_force, player.index)
444	            if new_leader then
445	                storage.team_leader[old_force_name] = new_leader.index
446	                old_force.custom_color = new_leader.color
447	                spawn_labels.refresh_for_force(old_force_name)
448	                local cn_leader = helpers.colored_name(new_leader.name, new_leader.chat_color)
449	                for _, member in pairs(old_force.players) do
450	                    if member.connected then
451	                        member.print(cn_leader .. " is now the leader of " .. team_tag .. ".")
452	                    end
453	                end
454	                helpers.broadcast("[Team] " .. cn_leader .. " now leads " .. team_tag .. ".")
455	            end
456	        end
457	    end
458	
459	    return true
460	end

13	-- on_surface_created, whose handler (events/ticks.lua) runs the existing flow
14	-- — normalize (skips it, non-variant) -> visibility -> spawn_labels.draw ->
15	-- raise_team_surface_created — against the ownership we registered first. Works
16	-- with or without Space Age (game.create_surface needs no planet).
17	--
18	-- Retire path: delete ONLY the named surface and unwind only its bookkeeping
19	-- (map entries + player_surfaces). It must NOT use cleanup_force_surfaces, which
20	-- deletes the WHOLE force's surfaces -- during a warp the team also owns the
21	-- just-created destination surface, which that would wrongly wipe. No event is
22	-- raised, so setup/teardown stay a predictable matched pair.
23	
24	-- No cycle now: remote_api injects this module (set_deferred_deps) rather than
25	-- requiring it, so team_surfaces -> surface_utils is a one-way edge.
26	local surface_utils = require("scripts.surface_utils")
27	local helpers       = require("scripts.helpers")
28	
29	local team_surfaces = {}
30	
31	-- Surface names whose on_team_surface_created raise is deferred until
32	-- create_team_surface finishes planet association + spawn-chunk pre-gen. Set and
33	-- cleared within a single synchronous create_team_surface call, so a plain
34	-- upvalue is desync-safe (every peer runs the same code path in the same tick).
35	local deferred = {}
36	
37	-- remote_api.raise_team_surface_created, injected at load time (this module must
38	-- NOT require remote_api -- see header). Doing the re-raise here rather than in
39	-- the mts-v1 wrapper means BOTH callers of create_team_surface get it (the wrapper
40	-- and the internal compat/mts_dimension_warp path).
41	local raise_hook = nil
42	
43	function team_surfaces.set_raise_hook(fn) raise_hook = fn end
44	
45	--- True while create_team_surface is mid-build for this surface name. The
46	--- events/ticks.lua on_surface_created handler checks this to SUPPRESS its inline
47	--- on_team_surface_created raise, so consumers don't see the surface before it has
48	--- a planet or any generated chunks; we re-raise once it is fully formed.
49	function team_surfaces.is_deferring(name)
50	    return deferred[name] == true
51	end
52	
53	local is_team_force = helpers.is_team_force
54	
55	-- ─── Create ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
56	
57	--- Create an ephemeral, caller-seeded surface for a team.
58	--- @param force_name string
59	--- @param spec table  { name = "mdw-vulcanus-w5", planet = "vulcanus", map_gen_settings = {...} }
60	---   name              REQUIRED, must be non-variant (not mts-<planet>-N / team-N-<planet>)
61	---   planet            base planet name; used only for Space Age association
62	---   map_gen_settings  the surface's settings, including the caller's seed
63	--- @return string|nil  the created surface name, or nil on failure
64	function team_surfaces.create_team_surface(force_name, spec)
65	    if not is_team_force(force_name) then return nil end
66	    spec = spec or {}
67	    local name = spec.name
68	    local base = spec.planet or "nauvis"
69	    if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then return nil end
70	
71	    local force = game.forces[force_name]
72	    if not (force and force.valid) then return nil end
73	
74	    -- Ownership of these ephemeral surfaces lives in a DEDICATED map that
75	    -- planet_map.build() never rewrites (the variant maps it does rewrite are
76	    -- regenerated from scratch on every on_configuration_changed, which used to
77	    -- orphan every surface registered here). See surface_utils.get_owner.
78	    storage.surface_owner_overrides = storage.surface_owner_overrides or {}
79	
80	    -- Idempotent: if the surface already exists, RE-ASSERT ownership and return.
81	    -- Re-asserting is what lets a consumer (e.g. MTS Dimension Warp) HEAL
82	    -- ownership that an earlier wipe dropped -- the old early-return wrote nothing,
83	    -- so a re-call could never repair a lost entry.
84	    if game.surfaces[name] then
85	        -- Only (re-)assert ownership when the surface is unowned or already ours.
86	        -- Refusing when another force owns it stops a consumer call with a
87	        -- colliding name from silently hijacking (and later deleting, via retire
88	        -- or the disband sweep) another team's surface. A dropped-override heal
89	        -- still works: that surface reports no owner, so cur == nil.
90	        local cur = surface_utils.get_owner(game.surfaces[name])
91	        if cur ~= nil and cur ~= force_name then return nil end
92	        storage.surface_owner_overrides[name] = force_name
93	        return name
94	    end
95	
96	    -- Register ownership BEFORE creation so the engine's on_surface_created
97	    -- handler resolves get_owner -> this force (driving visibility/labels).
98	    storage.surface_owner_overrides[name] = force_name
99	
100	    -- Defer the on_team_surface_created event: game.create_surface raises
101	    -- on_surface_created synchronously (events/ticks.lua), which would otherwise
102	    -- fire on_team_surface_created right now -- before the surface has a planet
103	    -- or any generated chunks. The marker makes the ticks.lua handler skip that
104	    -- inline raise; we re-raise below once the surface is fully formed.
105	    deferred[name] = true
106	
107	    -- Create with the caller's settings (seed included). The non-variant name
108	    -- means normalize_variant_seed leaves that seed untouched.
109	    local ok, surface = pcall(function() return game.create_surface(name, spec.map_gen_settings) end)
110	    if not (ok and surface and surface.valid) then
111	        deferred[name] = nil
112	        storage.surface_owner_overrides[name] = nil
113	        return nil
114	    end
115	
116	    -- Associate to the planet (non-nauvis) so Space Age planet mechanics apply.
117	    local planet = game.planets and game.planets[base]
118	    if planet and planet.valid and base ~= "nauvis" then
119	        pcall(function() planet.associate_surface(surface) end)
120	    end
121	
122	    -- Pre-generate the spawn area so a later clone/teleport lands on real terrain.
123	    surface.request_to_generate_chunks({0, 0}, 3)
124	    surface.force_generate_chunk_requests()
125	
126	    -- Surface now has its planet + spawn chunks: raise the deferred event so
127	    -- consumers (e.g. MTS Dimension Warp) see a fully-formed surface.
128	    deferred[name] = nil
129	    if raise_hook then raise_hook(surface.name, force_name) end
130	
131	    return surface.name
132	end
133	
134	-- ─── Retire ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
135	
136	--- Retire one surface owned by a team: delete it and unwind its bookkeeping.
137	--- @param force_name   string
138	--- @param surface_name string
139	--- @return boolean  true on success, false if the surface is invalid/not owned
140	---
141	--- Validate ownership, unwind ONLY this surface's bookkeeping, then delete just
142	--- this surface (game.delete_surface, async). Deliberately does NOT call
143	--- cleanup_force_surfaces, which deletes every surface the force owns --
144	--- including the destination surface the team just warped to.
145	function team_surfaces.retire_team_surface(force_name, surface_name)
146	    if not is_team_force(force_name) then return false end
147	    if type(surface_name) ~= "string" then return false end  -- AT-5: game.surfaces[<table>] errors
148	    local surface = game.surfaces[surface_name]
149	    if not (surface and surface.valid) then return false end
150	    if surface_utils.get_owner(surface) ~= force_name then return false end
151	
152	    -- Unwind ownership for THIS surface only. The override map is where ephemeral
153	    -- ownership now lives; the legacy variant-map unwinds are kept defensively for
154	    -- old saves that still have stray entries.
155	    if storage.surface_owner_overrides then storage.surface_owner_overrides[surface_name] = nil end
156	    if storage.map_planet_to_force then storage.map_planet_to_force[surface_name] = nil end
157	    local per_team = (storage.map_force_to_planets or {})[force_name]
158	    if per_team then
159	        for base, variant in pairs(per_team) do
160	            if variant == surface_name then per_team[base] = nil end
161	        end
162	    end
163	
164	    -- Drop any player home references to the retired surface.
165	    storage.player_surfaces = storage.player_surfaces or {}
166	    for idx, ps in pairs(storage.player_surfaces) do
167	        if ps.name == surface_name then storage.player_surfaces[idx] = nil end
168	    end
169	
170	    -- Delete ONLY this surface (async; fires on_surface_deleted later).
171	    game.delete_surface(surface)
172	    return true
173	end
174	
175	return team_surfaces

21	function tech_records.init_storage()
22	    storage.tech_records        = storage.tech_records        or {}
23	    storage.tech_research_ticks = storage.tech_research_ticks or {}
24	end

26	--- Handler for on_research_finished.
27	--- Records the research tick and checks for first/fastest records.
28	--- Returns true when a team record was updated (caller can refresh GUIs).
29	function tech_records.on_research_finished(event)
30	    local tech  = event.research
31	    local force = tech.force
32	
33	    -- Only track team forces (skip player/enemy/neutral/spectator)
34	    if not force_utils.is_team_force(force.name) then return false end
35	
36	    tech_records.init_storage()
37	
38	    -- Record the raw tick for legacy research diff UI
39	    storage.tech_research_ticks[force.name] = storage.tech_research_ticks[force.name] or {}
40	    storage.tech_research_ticks[force.name][tech.name] = game.tick
41	
42	    -- Space Age: unlock team's variant planet for planet-discovery techs.
43	    -- No-op when Space Age is inactive or tech isn't a discovery.
44	    planet_map.on_research_finished(tech)
45	
46	    -- Script-granted research (by_script) is not a player achievement, so don't
47	    -- record/announce a first/fastest for it. This covers admin /c research and
48	    -- mods that pre-grant techs -- e.g. MTS Dimension Warp pre-grants its
49	    -- un-craftable 'neo-nauvis' gate technology at team creation. The tick record
50	    -- above and the planet-variant unlock still apply; only the milestone
51	    -- record + broadcast + pop-text are skipped. (Engine-completed research,
52	    -- including research_trigger techs, has by_script=false and stays tracked.)
53	    if event.by_script then return false end
54	
55	    -- Update first/fastest records
56	    local result = records.update(storage.tech_records, tech.name, force.name, game.tick)
57	
58	    local team_tag = helpers.team_tag(force.name)
59	    local tech_tag = helpers.tech_rich_name(tech.name)
60	
61	    if result.is_first then
62	        helpers.broadcast(string.format(
63	            "%s %s was the first to research %s!",
64	            team_modifiers.records_tag(), team_tag, tech_tag
65	        ))
66	        pop_text.milestone(force, "First!\n[technology=" .. tech.name .. "]")
67	    elseif result.is_fastest then
68	        local prev = result.previous_fastest
69	        local new_entry = storage.tech_records[tech.name].fastest
70	        helpers.broadcast(string.format(
71	            "%s %s is fastest to research %s in %s (previous record: %s in %s)",
72	            team_modifiers.records_tag(),

78	        ))

80	    end

input.notes: Zero locale references in any of the 15 files — every display string is hardcoded English, so no 'localised'/'partial' entries exist. Structural points for the localisation plan: (1) Message pipeline: nearly all player-facing announcements flow through helpers.broadcast (game.print of a pre-assembled plain Lua string) and helpers.colored_name / helpers.team_tag / helpers.team_tag_with_leader (rich-text [color=] wrappers around team/player names) — helpers.lua was not in the scan set but is the choke point to convert to LocalisedString end-to-end. (2) remote_api.lua's bridge_text/connection_text/emit_chat/bridge_payload build Discord-bound sentences; these MUST remain plain strings (a LocalisedString cannot cross to Discord), so they need a separate single-language path, not locale keys — do not merge them with in-game message localisation. The bridge also receives static event descriptions (register_source) and emoji category labels. (3) team_modifiers.guidance() is a reusable sentence fragment appended to a broadcast, a HUD tooltip, and a join notice; the M.MODIFIERS spec table (label/short/icon/tooltip) is composed at four different sites (admin broadcast, HUD tag, Teams-card caption+tooltip, describe) — the worst sentence-fragment hotspot. (4) disable_blocked_reason hand-rolls English pluralisation (have/has, are/is); team_slots line 181 and team_rename line 45 hardcode plural nouns next to interpolated counts. (5) Default team display name string.format("Team %02d", slot) is baked into storage.team_names at pool creation and re-baked on release — persisted server-side, so it will stay in the server's language unless generation moves to a locale key resolved at display time. (6) spawn_labels.compute_text and the spectator chat prefixes build English possessive ("<name>'s") by concatenation; the spawn label is world-rendered text (rendering.draw_text) which only accepts LocalisedString in 2.0 if passed as such — currently plain. (7) pop_text.milestone strings mix literal text, \n, and [technology=] rich text. (8) team_rename.attempt returns raw English error strings printed by both the /mts-rename command and the Team Settings GUI — single source, easy to key. (9) All log() calls use a "[multi-team-support…]" prefix convention and are log-only; helpers.diag calls (ops.lua) assumed debug-gated (helpers.lua not read — verify).
